evidence: Gate.jl frozen_rounds doc: "A build refused ONLY for these is frozen". gate_problems: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes the :committed push, which needs `!in_ci && head != r.round["head"]`. Round builds use run_under_round (GBG_ROUND); release/doctor add GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP; logs go to scratch_dir. Only a bare local build changes: before, it skipped with exit 0 and built nothing ("Nothing was built"). Now it fails with exit 1, and the gate CLI refuses the same state.
